skill_name: Describe the political landscape in Turkey.
workflow: Turkey has a semi-presidential system of government with a president as the head of state, and a prime minister as the head of government. The current president, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, has been in power since 2014, and is generally seen as a conservative leader. Turkey has a multi-party system, and its politics are strongly influenced by several political parties including the Justice and Development Party (AKP), the Republican People's Party (CHP), and the Nationalist Movement Party (MHP).
